title: Mirabel and the Border
author: Zephyrine Nakamura
blurb: Silas Coldharbour, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
